title: Probability simplex embedding
statement: Let $\beta$ be a finite set and let $\sigma\in\beta$. The probability simplex embedding sends $\sigma$ to the coordinate vector in $\mathbb{R}^{\beta}$ whose $\sigma$-coordinate is $1$ and whose other coordinates are $0$.
